text: The instinct ("don't over-prescribe *how*, since the new arch may change the approach") is exactly right. But a single issue holding "a bunch of text" is, mechanically, **a scattered todo list / parallel roadmap living inside one issue** — which is the precise thing the planning-discipline rule bans, and the thing WIP.md was retired for. It just relocates the anti-pattern from a file to an issue body. Concretely you'd lose:
